```{r}

library(rwty)
library(RevGadgets)
library(tidyverse)
```

RWTY requires that MCMC chains are sampled at equal intervals. If the mcmc chains were not thinned equivalently, we can do resample them like so:

```{r}

continuous_relaxed <- readr::read_delim("new/Continuous(relaxed)_tree_samples.trees", delim = "\t" )
continuous_strict <- readr::read_delim("new/Continuous(strict)_tree_samples.trees", delim = "\t" )
discrete_table <- readr::read_delim("new/Discrete_tree_samples.trees", delim = "\t")
combined_relaxed <- readr::read_delim("new/Combined_relaxed.trees", delim = "\t")
combined_strict <- readr::read_delim("new/combined(strict_nosa)_tree_samples.trees", delim = "\t")


#continuous_table <- sample_frac(continuous_table, size = .1, replace = FALSE)
#discrete_table <- sample_frac(discrete_table, size = .1, replace = FALSE)
#combined <- sample_frac(continuous_table, size = .1, replace = FALSE)

#write_delim(continuous_table, "dated/continuous_subsample.trees", delim = "\t")
#write_delim(discrete_table, "dated/discrete_subsample.trees", delim = "\t")
#write_delim(continuous_table, "dated/combined_subsample.trees", delim = "\t")
continuous_relaxed <- continuous_relaxed %>%
 slice(which(row_number() %% 1 == 1)) %>% 
#  select(-Iteration, -Posterior, -Likelihood, -Prior) %>% 
  write_delim("new/subsampled/continuous_relaxed.trees", delim = "\t")

continuous_strict <- continuous_strict %>%
 slice(which(row_number() %% 10 == 1)) %>% 
#  select(-Iteration, -Posterior, -Likelihood, -Prior) %>% 
  write_delim("new/subsampled/continuous_strict.trees", delim = "\t")

discrete_table <- discrete_table %>%
 slice(which(row_number() %% 100 == 1)) %>% 
#  select(-Iteration, -Posterior, -Likelihood, -Prior) %>% 
  write_delim("new/subsampled/discrete_subsample.trees", delim = "\t")

combined_relaxed <- combined_relaxed %>% 
   slice(which(row_number() %% 100 == 1)) %>% 
 # select(-Iteration, -Posterior, -Likelihood, -Prior) %>% 
  write_delim("new/subsampled/combined_relaxed.trees", delim = "\t")

combined_strict <- combined_strict %>% 
   slice(which(row_number() %% 100 == 1)) %>% 
 # select(-Iteration, -Posterior, -Likelihood, -Prior) %>% 
  write_delim("new/subsampled/combined_strict.trees", delim = "\t")


```


```{r}

continuous_parameters <- readr::read_delim("dated/Continuous Only.log", delim = "\t" )
discrete_parameters <- readr::read_delim("dated/Discrete Only.log", delim = "\t")
combined_parameters <- readr::read_delim("dated/Combined.log", delim = "\t")

#continuous_table <- sample_frac(continuous_table, size = .1, replace = FALSE)
#discrete_table <- sample_frac(discrete_table, size = .1, replace = FALSE)
#combined <- sample_frac(continuous_table, size = .1, replace = FALSE)

#write_delim(continuous_table, "dated/continuous_subsample.trees", delim = "\t")
#write_delim(discrete_table, "dated/discrete_subsample.trees", delim = "\t")
#write_delim(continuous_table, "dated/combined_subsample.trees", delim = "\t")
continuous_parameters <- continuous_parameters %>%
 slice(which(row_number() %% 10 == 1)) %>% 
#  select(-Iteration, -Posterior, -Likelihood, -Prior) %>% 
  write_delim("dated/subsampled/continuous_subsample.log", delim = "\t")

discrete_parameters %>%
 slice(which(row_number() %% 10 == 1)) %>% 
#  select(-Iteration, -Posterior, -Likelihood, -Prior) %>% 
  write_delim("dated/discrete_subsample.log", delim = "\t")

combined_parameters %>% 
   slice(which(row_number() %% 10 == 1)) %>% 
 # select(-Iteration, -Posterior, -Likelihood, -Prior) %>% 
  write_delim("dated/subsampled/combined_subsample.log", delim = "\t")


```


```{r}

my.trees <- load.multi(path = "~/Desktop/manuscript_data/output/", format = "revbayes")
#path Can be dated/ for the dated trees or undated/ for the undateds
```

```{r}

for (x in length(my.trees$strict.trees$trees)){
    my.trees$strict.trees$trees[[x]] <- SA_nodesToTips(my.trees$strict.trees$trees[[x]])
}

```



```{r}

my.treespace <- makeplot.treespace(my.trees, n.points = 100,
                    fill.color = NA)

```

Plot it a little better:

```{r}

 qplot(x, y, data = my.treespace$treespace.points.plot$data, color = chain, shape = chain) + scale_color_manual(values = c("#004D40","#751F96", "#751F96","#FFC107","#FFC107")) + scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 16, 17, 17, 16 )) +theme_bw()
```
